Office printer, redesigned for trust.

A multifunction office printer whose colour tells you what to do: lavender parts are the ones you lift, load or adjust; mauve means press or release.

See it in your room

  1. Phone or tablet: AR with labelsTap AR with labels, allow the camera, and the printer appears in front of you at full size. Turn the phone to look around it, drag to spin it, pinch to resize, and tap any number to watch that part work.
  2. iPhone or iPad: true floor placementTap Place at true size to pin it to your floor and walk around it. Apple's viewer can't show the numbers, so use the first option to see the parts move.
  3. AndroidPlace in your room pins it to the floor and keeps the buttons and numbers on screen.
  4. ComputerTurn and zoom the model here. Labels shows the numbers, Open all opens every door and drawer, Spin turns it for you.

Parts · tap one to watch it work

    Every number does something: tap it and that part moves, glows or lights up so you can see what it is for. In AR it stands at its real size, so you can check it against a desk or a doorway.
